England to Introduce New Vocational GCSEs from 2029

The UK government announced that, from 2029, teenagers in England will be offered a new suite of vocational GCSE qualifications, including subjects such as finance and construction. The Guardian reported that the reforms are presented as part of the prime minister’s education push to provide a pathway for all young people and to address a crisis that has left nearly a million youths without prospects. The Daily Mirror noted that the changes are accompanied by the No10 North work‑experience scheme.
